metadata.description: LLM Wiki v2: a Claude Code plugin for durable knowledge bases with section-level retrieval, structured evidence, caching, optional embeddings, and a compiled graph.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Build and maintain an LLM-curated personal knowledge base with section-level BM25 search, structured JSON evidence, incremental caching, optional hybrid embeddings, and a compiled graph layer. Includes the llm-wiki skill and seven /wiki:* commands.
